amendments.reason: connectors spec task 9.1: `connectors` adds `fitdocs pull`, a second writer into the configured inbox, which removes its own archived, content-identical prior deliveries once re-delivered. Requirement 6's never-delete guarantee (6.6) and leave-in-place default (6.1) were written before any other writer existed and, read alone, appear to bind every removal under the inbox directory.
amendments.also: requirements.md gains Amendment 1 (2026-10-01) and Requirement 6 criterion 6.8, clarifying that 6.1 and 6.6 are the drain's own guarantees and do not constrain a connector's own narrower removal, which `connectors` Requirement 8 owns and governs. Nothing renumbered.
